name: Data Modeling & Schema Design
description: Data Modeling & Schema Design standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-DATA applies.

rules.title: Model business invariants in the database where appropriate
rules.detail: Use primary keys, foreign keys, uniqueness, nullability and check constraints to protect durable invariants in addition to application validation.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Model business invariants in the database where appropriate.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Model business invariants in the database where appropriate.

rules.title: Use consistent identity and audit fields
rules.detail: Define project conventions for surrogate/natural keys, created/updated timestamps, actor fields and soft-delete behavior where needed.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Use consistent identity and audit fields.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Use consistent identity and audit fields.

rules.title: Choose data types that preserve meaning
rules.detail: Use timezone-aware timestamps for instants, fixed precision for money, explicit length/precision and domain-appropriate types rather than generic strings.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Choose data types that preserve meaning.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Choose data types that preserve meaning.

rules.title: Design indexes from real query patterns
rules.detail: Index selective filter/join/order columns based on measured access paths; review write/storage cost and avoid redundant indexes.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Design indexes from real query patterns.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Design indexes from real query patterns.

rules.title: Define ownership and lifecycle for each data set
rules.detail: Identify source of truth, writers, retention, archival/deletion and consistency expectations.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Define ownership and lifecycle for each data set.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Define ownership and lifecycle for each data set.

rules.title: Avoid embedding presentation concerns in canonical data
rules.detail: Persist stable business codes/values and localize/format them in presentation or explicit projection layers.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Avoid embedding presentation concerns in canonical data.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Avoid embedding presentation concerns in canonical data.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-DATA applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Data Modeling & Schema Design to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Data Modeling & Schema Design is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Data Modeling & Schema Design failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
